record.paper: Notes on Cops and Robber game on graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Notes on Cops and Robber game on graphs
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Question (Riemannian surfaces): cop converging to robber
dossier_meta.statement_text: If the cops have a strategy to catch the robber, could it in fact be achieved that one of the cops comes arbitrarily close to the robber (or even onto the same point) in the continuous version of the game?
dossier_meta.context_text: In the continuous game on a Riemannian surface a robber is 'caught' when a cop comes within distance $\frac{1}{2}$. The author asks whether a winning strategy can always be strengthened so that a cop actually converges to the robber's exact position.
